product_name: PD1180-EPR — NEMA 34 Smart Motor-Mounted Stepper Controller with USB-C PD 3.1 EPR

requirements.input: USB-C PD 3.1 EPR 48 V / 5 A contract
requirements.motor_current_note: Locked low-current commissioning only; no qualified run current.

order_hold_reasons: Eight J1/J10 hole-clearance errors remain as explicitly requested; this is an engineering review exception, not fabrication acceptance. Cosmetic silkscreen findings remain visible.
The 6 A/phase behavioral worst-case bus reaches 54.858 V and lacks the allocated 0.5 V margin below the 55 V system limit. Full-current running is unqualified; firmware motion remains locked.
DDV top-side heatsink/TIM/mechanical clearance and motor-current operating envelope are not qualified.
Exact stock is not reserved: latest evidence records shortages for R66, R60, BZ1, J1/J10 and U7 (four available for five boards). Refresh the entire fitted BOM before procurement.
Rear fastening, single-shaft encoder magnet attachment and physical acceptance of the selected WAGO clamps, actual harnesses and PD_READY/ADC fault behavior require closure.
TI EEPROM and RP2040 flash programming/readback/cold boot, USB current, brake and loaded thermal/EMC tests require assembled hardware. All four firmware qualification locks remain false.
prototype_gate_scope: CAD and source/firmware implementation only, under the locked low-current commissioning envelope. The driver/protection gate does not qualify 6 A operation; the recorded 6 A energy-margin failure and all physical gates remain open. Exact USB-hole and cosmetic exceptions are engineering-review only.
